structured_output.world_model:
W2 (empirical), after E062. Tip E061: 5.0235 s, 0.7534 (seeds 0-2). Same-commit rebuilds move the 3-seed mean about 0.1-0.3 pp (E036: 0.7497-0.7544; E049: 0.7535/0.7552/0.7536) and time about 0.03-0.05 s.

Mechanisms, each tied to its experiments:
1. Epoch dial: about 0.8-1.5 s/pp. E061 (−12 early 20 px steps) saved about 0.15 s at about 0 pp on 3 seeds. I price the dial at about 1 s/pp.
2. EMA (+0.97 pp, E005) and Muon are in the tip. E062 shows that dropping Muon for SGD costs 2.3 pp, so Muon is real here and PR #3 does not transfer. More than 10 time-neutral boosters (E025, E029, E030, E032, E044, wd and LS) came out flat or negative, so I expect further tweaks to land within ±0.15 pp of zero.
3. Time tracks pixels and steps. Early 20 px is nearly free (E026, E033). Removing steps or samples costs about the dial's rate (E031, E040, E041, E048).
4. Backward truncation is the best lever (E028, E034, E036, E046, E049). Freezing the stem before about 75% loses (E037, E054, E055). Group 2 tolerates a freeze from 85-90%. The whitening detach at 6% saved little (E060).
5. Activation and architecture cuts cost accuracy at the dial's rate or worse (E010, E021, E051, E056). ReLU saved 0.25 s and cost 0.5 pp. Optimizer swaps and other big changes can lose a lot (E062).
6. Non-step overhead is about 2.5% (E047).
7. Noise: the population mean is about 0.752-0.7535, so headroom over the bar is about 0.2 pp. Seed sets used for keeps carry a winner's curse of 0.1-0.2 pp.

Misses: I over-predicted time when variants cut work (E052, E056, E062). E062's accuracy came in far below my range, because I underrated Muon. I under-predicted accuracy on E053. My time ranges should lean lower for work cuts.

Unsure:
- Rebuild SD of a 20-seed mean (guess 0.08 pp).
- Whether tanh-GELU or SiLU gives a real time saving.
- Whether the PCIe judge's build matches the local one.
- Whether early-trim savings continue linearly beyond 225 steps.

forecasts.reason: Offline profile likely shows tanh-GELU saves under 1.5%, so the gate closes with no run and the tip numbers stay the same.
Another 12 steps save about 0.14 s, with about −0.1 pp expected. This is likely within noise and borderline for the gate.
The width cut likely runs at about 1.3 s/pp, worse than the dial; E010 showed that.
Architecture cuts have cost more than the dial (E051, E021), so removing a conv probably loses about 0.4 pp.
The saving is small, since the 24 px phase is only about 24 steps. The loss is probably about 0.1 pp.
The time is unchanged. LS tweaks have been flat at the measured power.

cruxes: Is the per-pp price of early 20 px step trimming still about 0.3-0.5 s/pp beyond 225 steps, or does it jump to the dial's 1 s/pp?
Is the rebuild SD of a 20-seed mean about 0.05 pp or about 0.15 pp? This decides whether any sub-0.15 pp keep is real.
Does tanh-GELU or SiLU save at least 1.5% of step time under Inductor, or is the GELU cost memory-bound?
